description: GOXDUU crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C81 H54 Er1 N9 Nd1 O9 Yb1,2(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Er3 (Er) has 4 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 7 O neighbors; Yb1 (Yb) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.573-3.586 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.34-99.66°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula NdErYbQ9 (Q = 8-quinolinolato); crystal form C81H54ErN9NdO9Yb·2(CH3CN); bulk analysis consistent with NdErYbQ9·3H2O.
